summary.text: Chris Adams is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 37B who was first elected in 2014 and has served since January 14, 2015.
Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate list shows Christopher T. Adams as an incumbent running in District 37B; a business owner, he serves on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Chris Adams was born in Salisbury, Maryland, on June 19, 1972, and graduated from Wicomico Senior High School in 1990, according to his General Assembly biography.
He earned a B.S. in business management in 1994 and an MBA in 1996 from the Franklin P. Perdue School of Business at Salisbury State University.
Adams has been president of Value Carpet One since 2001 and president of S. Lee Smith Jr., Inc., a family real estate business, since 2001.
Adams has served on the Economic Matters Committee since 2015 and has chaired the Eastern Shore House Delegation since 2022.
He was Minority Whip and Deputy Minority Whip in 2021 and chaired the Dorchester County House Delegation from 2015 to 2023.
